jobs.title: Data Analyst, New Grad
jobs.description:
Jobright is your personal AI job search agent that transforms the way you do job search from solo, time-consuming efforts to a fast, expert-guided journey, simplifying every job search step and accelerating your route to the best job outcomes. As a Data Analyst, New Grad, you will work onsite with product, engineering, and AI teams to turn product, job market, and user data into insights that directly influence product development.

Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Analyze product, user, and job market data to identify trends and opportunities
• Write SQL queries and build reports, dashboards, and analytical tools
• Define and monitor key product and business metrics
• Support A/B tests and evaluate new product features
• Investigate data quality issues and improve reporting accuracy
• Present findings to product, engineering, and business stakeholders
• Collaborate closely with the team in an onsite environment
Qualification

Required

• Recent graduate or graduating soon in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field
• Strong SQL skills and familiarity with spreadsheets or Python
• Understanding of basic statistics, data analysis, and experimentation
• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work onsite in the SF Bay Area

Preferred

• Experience with pandas, scikit-learn, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools
• Familiarity with product analytics, recommendation systems, or search
• Experience working with large or messy datasets
• Previous internship, research, or analytics project experience

jobs.title: Associate Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About Our Client
The organization operates in the social media and broadcast analytics space, providing platforms and tools that measure key performance indicators across various channels, teams, media outlets, and properties. It addresses the challenge of interpreting large volumes of social media data to deliver actionable insights that support content strategies and sponsorship value optimization.
About the Opportunity
The Associate Data Analyst
role focuses on leveraging the company's platform to analyze social media and broadcast data, providing insights to internal teams and external clients. This position contributes to the development of analytical methodologies, supports product improvement, and assists in delivering data-driven recommendations to enhance client content strategies and sponsorship outcomes.
Responsibilities
Utilize the platform to quantify social media and broadcast KPIs across diverse channels and properties
Identify and interpret trends in social media data at multiple levels
Analyze results and communicate insights to stakeholders
Recommend and develop industry benchmarks for clients and sponsors
Collaborate with Customer Success teams to advise on social media content strategies
Examine data quality and support database applications and analytical tools
Contribute to product development and improvements in data presentation
Engage users in data collection and query system processes

Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field
1–3 years of experience as a Data Analyst, preferably with exposure to marketing, communications, digital strategy, or the sports industry
Strong technical knowledge combined with strategic thinking
Solid understanding of business, data, and statistical concepts
Ability to develop methodologies for data collection, analysis, and presentation
Effective problem-solving and communication skills
Ability to interpret organizational data trends
Experience with database and data system design
Self-motivated and proactive

Pay Range and Compensation Package
The pay range and compensation package for this role will be determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, and other relevant factors.

Equal Opportunity Statement: Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

Note:
RemoteHunter is not the Employer of Record (EOR) for this role. Our purpose in this opportunity is to connect exceptional candidates with leading employers. We help job seekers worldwide discover roles that match their goals and guide them to complete their full application directly through the hiring company’s career page or ATS.

jobs.title: Contracts Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview

Joint Strategic Technologies (JST) is seeking a mid-level Contracts Data Analyst to support data organization, dashboard creation, and platform management for Department of State (DOS) contracting operations. Working directly under the direction of the JST Program Management Lead, this individual will structure incoming contracting data, build interactive visualization tools, and optimize data workflows across Power BI, SharePoint, and Smartsheet.The ideal candidate possesses strong hands-on technical capabilities in data management and reporting, coupled with a solid foundational understanding of federal acquisition processes.

This is a full-time position in Washington, D.C.
JST offers a full benefit package, a collaborative work environment and strong company culture. Veterans and military spouses are encouraged to apply.

Contract Data Analyst Responsibilities

Dashboard & Visualization Development: Design, build, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards, Smartsheet trackers, and customized visual reports to provide actionable metrics for leadership and the PM Lead.
Data Architecture & Organization: Collaborate with the JST PM Lead to identify data requirements, structure incoming contracting data, and establish best practices for data taxonomy, storage, and workflow automation.
Platform Administration: Configure and maintain SharePoint sites, lists, libraries, and Smartsheet workspace solutions to streamline contract tracking and team collaboration.
Data Input & Integrity: Input, clean, structure, and validate high volumes of contracting actions and financial data across government and internal systems.
Contract Action Tracking: Support tracking of key acquisition steps, milestones, deliverables, and billing lifecycle metrics (e.g., electronic invoicing/Closeout workflow monitoring).
Operational Reporting: Produce recurring and ad-hoc analytical reports, summaries, and executive presentations detailing procurement performance metrics.

Contracts Data Analyst Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
Data Analytics & Visualization: 3–5 years of demonstrated hands-on experience using Power BI, Smartsheet, and Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables, data modeling) to organize datasets and build custom dashboards.
Platform Experience: Experience configuring, building, and managing SharePoint pages, lists, and document repositories.
Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written, verbal, and visual presentation skills, with a proven ability to translate complex datasets into clear business insights for team leads and stakeholders.
Detail Orientation: High precision in manual and automated data entry, recordkeeping, and dataset reconciliation.

Contracts Data Analyst Desired Qualifications

Federal Acquisition Context: Prior experience supporting federal procurement, contract administration, or a Department of State (DOS) acquisition shop (e.g., familiar with 1102 concepts, contract lifecycle, or federal invoicing flows such as iRAPT, EDA, CDR, or Closeout).
Business Intelligence: Experience with automated data workflows (e.g., Power Automate) or connecting disparate data sources into central BI repositories.

Required Clearances And Screenings

MUST have an active secret clearance
MUST be able to pass a US Government Security Clearance

About Joint Strategic Technologies (JST)

No objective is beyond reach! Joint Strategic Technologies (JST) enables successful mission outcomes from the back office to the battlefield. Our team includes leading experts from military, government and the private sector, all working together to help federal customers make a difference. Our goal is to Elevate the Impact that our employees have on our customers and treat every employee as a valued member of our team. JST empowers employees to make decisions and take-action, thus improving overall organizational growth and employee development.

Culture isn't something you talk about. It's something you do. JST is committed to creating a positive environment 'that reaches beyond work and careers' to support every employee's professional and personal objectives. JST values the well-being of every employee and encourages healthy lifestyles, family activities and community involvement.

JST is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. JST will not tolerate discrimination or harassment.
